title: Finite-stage K-flatness of split free cells
statement: Let R be a commutative ring. For a sequence F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat R) ℤ and maps step m : F m ⟶ F (m+1), assume F 0 is zero, every step has a degreewise retraction, every quotient cokernel (step m) has zero differential, and every quotient term is a free R-module. Then every finite stage F m is K-flat: (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat (F m).

proof.text: Induct on m. The zero stage is K-flat. For the successor, the degreewise retraction splits the tensor short exact sequence with the quotient; the zero-differential free quotient tensors an acyclic complex to an acyclic direct sum. The long exact homology sequence gives K-flatness of the successor.

theorem kFlat_of_split_free_cells_finite_stage {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (step : ∀ m : ℕ, F m ⟶ F (m + 1))
    (hzero : IsZero (F 0))
    (hsplit : ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ),
      ∃ r : (F (m + 1)).X n ⟶ (F m).X n,
        (step m).f n ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F m).X n))
    (hquot_d : ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ), (cokernel (step m)).d n (n + 1) = 0)
    (hquot_free : ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ),
      Module.Free R ((cokernel (step m)).X n)) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat (F m)
